purpose: Teach: 見捨て/テック/送り出し/王家/シリアル/樽/鍛える/野心

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、お客さん、絶対、見捨てない姿勢、店の信条として、本気で、続けていこか、葵で、絶対、貫いていきたいで、本当に、本気で。
lines.en: Aoi — we have to keep this as the core of the shop. Never abandoning a customer. That's the real principle here, and I want you to hold that line. Absolutely.
lines.style: Kansai warmth with underlying intensity. Opens firm but not harsh. Leans forward slightly as he settles into conviction. Rhythmic pulse on the key promises. Breath visible under the words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。テック企業のお客様、葵で、最近、増えております、新しい、お話、本気で、楽しみですね、葵で、お客様、皆、楽しんでくださっています、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We're getting more tech company customers lately, and they're bringing fresh conversations. I'm genuinely excited about that, and honestly, all our guests seem to be enjoying themselves.
lines.style: Genuine brightness without forced cheerfulness. Speaks with the quiet pride of someone who's been paying attention. Slight lift on 'fresh conversations.' Warm eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: お客さんの送り出し、葵で、最後まで、心を、込めて、行いたいで、本気で、絶対、おもてなしの心、貫いてまいろうな、葵さん、本当に、本気。
lines.en: I want to send every customer off with real care until the very last moment. That's the hospitality we're going to keep living by, Aoi. Really and truly.
lines.style: Slower than before. Weight on each phrase like he's laying stones. Soft Kansai cadence. Gaze held steady. The voice of someone making a quiet vow, not a demand.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。王家の食卓のような、特別なコース、葵で、新メニューに、加えませんか、本気で、面白い、企画に、なりそうですね、絶対、本当に、お客様、喜ぶ。
lines.en: Yes. What if we created a special tasting menu inspired by a royal table — something we could add to the new offerings? It sounds like it would be a really interesting concept, and I think the customers would absolutely love it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wondering aloud. Pace slightly slower to let the idea breathe. Warm at the end, as if already imagining the guests' faces.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 朝食メニュー、シリアル、お洒落なもの、葵で、提供したいんや、本気で、健康志向のお客さん、本気で、喜んでくれるはずや、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: I want to start offering beautiful, elegant cereals for breakfast. Seriously. The health-conscious customers we get would genuinely appreciate it. I'm sure of that.
lines.style: Animated but grounded. Quick warm energy on the opening. Slight Kansai roll. Conviction underneath — he's thought about this. Not performative, just certain.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。ワイン樽の、デコレーション、店内に、本気で、増やしましょう、葵で、雰囲気、本当に、お洒落になりますよ、絶対、本気で、本当に、お客様、好評、続きそう。
lines.en: Yes. Let's really increase the wine barrel decorations throughout the shop. It'll make the atmosphere genuinely refined and sophisticated, and I think our customers will keep coming back for that feeling.
lines.style: Bright, flowing naturally from one image to the next. Light and positive. The warmth of someone painting a picture they want to see. Slight breathiness on 'sophisticated.'

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 料理人として、技を、本気で、鍛える日々、続けていくで、葵さん、絶対、葵に、相応しい料理人、目指しまーす、本気で、本当に、絶対、頑張ろうな、葵さん。
lines.en: As a chef, I'm going to keep sharpening my skills every single day. I want to be the kind of chef who truly belongs here at Aoi, Aoi. I'm going to give it everything, alongside you.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Slow opening. Deep breath visible on 'every single day.' The voice settles into resolve. Gaze direct. Not bragging — stating a commitment he's already made to himself.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。葵を、業界の、一流店に、する野心、本気で、持っております、絶対、葵さんと、一緒に、頑張ってまいりましょう、本当に、本気で、絶対、夢、叶えたい、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I really do hold the ambition of making Aoi into a top-tier establishment in this industry. Let's keep working hard together — genuinely, earnestly. I want us to make this dream real. Together.
lines.style: Mirroring his seriousness but adding her own quieter warmth. Pace steady and sure. Breath even. The final repetitions feel like a promise being sealed, not a plea.
